allow: PowerShell(Start-Process powershell -ArgumentList "-NoProfile -WindowStyle Hidden -File `"$env:TEMP\\cap2.ps1`"" -WindowStyle Hidden; Write-Output "Capture script launched")

PowerShell(Start-Sleep -Seconds 18; $e = Get-Process -Name "electron" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Output "Electron: $\($e.Count\) procesos"; $e | Select-Object Id, MainWindowTitle | Format-Table -AutoSize)

PowerShell(Start-Sleep -Seconds 20; $e = Get-Process -Name "electron" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Output "Electron: $\($e.Count\) procesos"; $e | Where-Object { $_.MainWindowTitle -ne '' } | Select-Object Id, MainWindowTitle)
